definition: Kraken2 root-classified reads divided by total input reads in a valid native report
denominator: All input reads for that sample
interpretation: Technical fraction of input reads assigned somewhere in the frozen database/classifier grammar
main_limitation: Depends on host content, upstream processing, read architecture and database coverage; not absolute bacterial burden
cross_cohort_role: Descriptive comparability only; cohort-level inferential comparison is invalid because cohort and preprocessing are confounded

definition: Number of species taxids with positive direct-assigned reads in a valid report
denominator: No abundance denominator; detection count per sample
interpretation: Observed breadth of the direct species assignment subcomposition
main_limitation: Strongly depth, classifier-yield and threshold dependent
cross_cohort_role: Directional concordance is valid with qualification; raw levels should not be pooled

definition: Negative sum of p times log(p) over positive species direct counts
denominator: p is each species direct count divided by the sum of species direct counts in that sample
interpretation: Evenness-weighted diversity within the classified species subcomposition
main_limitation: Ignores unclassified mass and is not absolute microbial burden; zero/detection sensitivity
cross_cohort_role: Contrast-specific standardized direction may be compared with qualification, not meta-analyzed

definition: One minus the sum of squared species direct-count proportions
denominator: Sum of species direct counts in that sample
main_limitation: Subcomposition and classifier dependent; insensitive to absolute microbial amount
cross_cohort_role: Contrast-specific direction and uncertainty may be shown side by side

definition: Maximum species direct count divided by summed species direct counts
denominator: Sum of species direct counts in that sample
interpretation: Share of the most directly assigned species within the species subcomposition
main_limitation: Can be driven by one classification and says nothing about absolute burden
cross_cohort_role: Directional ecological behavior may be compared with qualification

definition: Proportion of valid cohort reports with a positive direct count for a taxid
denominator: All valid samples in that cohort
interpretation: Detection frequency under the common classifier grammar
main_limitation: Depends on read depth, classifier yield and cohort-specific feature observability
cross_cohort_role: VALID for independently calculated overlap summaries; never calculate on pooled 530 samples

definition: Pairwise Bray-Curtis distance on direct species counts divided by all input reads, using taxa present in at least 10% within that cohort
denominator: Pairwise sum of the two all-read fraction vectors
interpretation: Existing sensitivity layer combining changes in observed composition and total assigned-species fraction
main_limitation: Not a log-ratio geometry; sample-wise total assigned fraction can affect distance; dispersion sensitivity
cross_cohort_role: Effect-size/dispersion behavior may be compared only with qualification

definition: Permutation test of group-associated centroid/location structure in a prespecified distance matrix
denominator: Total distance-matrix variation; report pseudo-F and R2
interpretation: Magnitude and evidence for a within-cohort clinical association in community space
main_limitation: Can reflect dispersion; design and permutation restrictions matter; R2 depends on group structure
anchor_role: PRIMARY with Aitchison; existing Bray-Curtis sensitivity
external_role: PRIMARY with Aitchison; existing Bray-Curtis sensitivity
cross_cohort_role: Side-by-side R2 is qualified ecological concordance, not a shared coefficient

definition: Permutation test of group differences in distance to group centroid using the same samples and distance as PERMANOVA
interpretation: Determines whether a PERMANOVA result is dispersion-qualified
main_limitation: Does not repair confounding or identify biological location effects by itself
cross_cohort_role: Dispersion behavior may be compared descriptively across cohorts

definition: Intersection of species taxids detected in at least 10% of valid samples in each cohort
denominator: Separate cohort sample counts: 400 and 130; intersection n=166 taxids
interpretation: Shared observable species inventory under the same classifier grammar
main_limitation: Threshold and detection dependent; shared presence is not equal abundance or effect
cross_cohort_role: VALID taxonomic-overlap result with technical qualification

definition: Intersection of genus taxids detected in at least 10% of valid samples in each cohort
denominator: Separate cohort sample counts: 400 and 130; intersection n=45 taxids
interpretation: Shared observable genus inventory under the same classifier grammar
main_limitation: Lower rank resolution may collapse distinct organisms; prevalence remains depth dependent
cross_cohort_role: VALID taxonomic-overlap result with technical qualification

definition: Intersection and union summaries of observed taxids at prespecified prevalence thresholds
denominator: Cohort-specific observed taxon sets, never pooled samples
interpretation: Extent of common classifier observability across cohorts
main_limitation: Pipeline/read differences and ecological setting both influence overlap; absence is not proof of biological absence
cross_cohort_role: VALID_WITH_QUALIFICATION; supports common inventory, not clinical replication
